# GitHub Release Template

## Install Scripts

### Panel

Latest:
```bash
curl -fL https://github.com/ImoLR/FLVXR2/releases/latest/download/panel_install.sh -o panel_install.sh && chmod +x panel_install.sh && ./panel_install.sh
```

Specific version:
```bash
curl -fL https://github.com/ImoLR/FLVXR2/releases/download/3.0.27-fork.2/panel_install.sh -o panel_install.sh && chmod +x panel_install.sh && ./panel_install.sh 3.0.27-fork.2
```

### Node

Latest:
```bash
curl -fL https://github.com/ImoLR/FLVXR2/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && chmod +x install.sh && ./install.sh
```

Specific version:
```bash
curl -fL https://github.com/ImoLR/FLVXR2/releases/download/3.0.27-fork.2/install.sh -o install.sh && chmod +x install.sh && ./install.sh 3.0.27-fork.2
```

## Default Account

- Username: `admin_user`
- Password: `admin_user`

Change the default password after the first login.
